SETUP_TOKEN.description: Opens the `/setup` wizard. At least 32 random characters, for example from `openssl rand -base64 33`. Remove it after setup.

USER_KEK.description: Wraps the private keys of local accounts. A long random value, for example from `openssl rand -base64 33`. Keep a copy: keys wrapped with it cannot be read with any other value.

MEDIA.description: R2 bucket for uploaded media. Choose a name no other Worker uses.

QUEUE.description: Queue for federation delivery and inbox replay. Choose a name no other Worker uses; this Worker is its only consumer.
